docs.desc: PRESS RELEASE OF EOG RESOURCES, INC.

reports.title: (B)See Note 5 to the Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements in EOG’s Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q for the quarterly period ended September 30, 2026.

desk.headline: Revenue up 46% to $8.5bn and adjusted EPS $4.87, both beat; output up 10%, $1.6bn returned to shareholders
results: Total revenue rose 46% to $8.5bn as realised oil averaged $86.72 a barrel against $65.95 a year ago.
Adjusted EPS was $4.87 versus $2.71; reported diluted EPS was $5.33, helped by $242m of gains on asset sales.
Output rose 10% to 1.43m boe/d, with oil at 550,400 bbl/d (+3%) and gas and NGLs growing faster.
Free cash flow was $2.2bn on $1.6bn of capital spending; $1.06bn of buybacks and $544m of dividends were paid.
Net debt fell to $2.2bn (6% of capital); the dividend declared was $1.02 a share.

guidance.summary: The outlook pages of the press release were not available for this summary, so guidance is not covered here.

watch: Any change to 2026 capital and production plans in the full release or 10-Q.
Pace of buybacks after $2.8bn in the first nine months.
Oil prices after the drop from $98 realised in Q2 to $87 in Q3.
